name: Archived Project Permanent Delete
description: Add bulk permanent delete for archived projects on `/projects/archived` while preserving shared article, prompt, and judgment data.

userStories.title: Make judgment_human project links nullable
userStories.description: As a developer, I want `app.judgment_human.project_id` to allow `NULL` so that archived projects can be deleted without removing preserved human judgments.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a DuckDB migration that makes `app.judgment_human.project_id` nullable
The updated schema supports preserved `app.judgment_human` rows with `project_id = NULL`
`bun run lint` passes
`bun run db:mig` passes

userStories.title: Add archived-project delete route and core cleanup
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bulk archived-project delete API so that only archived projects can be permanently removed together with their project-owned operational data.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `POST /api/projects/delete-archived` with body `{projectIds: string[]}`
Reject requests that include active projects or projects with non-terminal `app.judgment_job` rows

Delete project-owned rows for `app.token_use`, `app.judgment_job_prompt`, `app.judgment_job`, `app.review`, `app.project_import_route`, `app.project_article`, `app.project_prompt`, `app.mart_refresh_queue`, and `app.project` in a transaction
Add route tests proving active projects are rejected and archived projects can be deleted
`bun run lint` passes
`bun run db:mig` passes
`bun test src/server/routes/ProjectsRoutes.test.ts` passes

userStories.title: Preserve shared records during archived delete
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want archived-project deletion to preserve judgments and clean surviving provenance references so that permanent deletes do not destroy shared data.
acceptanceCriteria: Null `app.project_article.imported_from_project_id` and `app.project_prompt.origin_project_id` when they point at deleted projects
Preserve `app.judgment` and `app.judgment_human` rows by setting `project_id = NULL` during archived-project delete
Purge project-scoped cache and mart rows using the same table set as `purgeArchivedProjectMartData`
Extend route tests to cover provenance nulling, preserved judgments, and mart/cache cleanup
`bun run lint` passes
`bun run db:mig` passes
`bun test src/server/routes/ProjectsRoutes.test.ts` passes

userStories.title: Add archived-project bulk delete client helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a client helper for archived-project bulk delete so that the archived projects screen can call the new API and refresh project queries consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `deleteArchivedProjects(queryClient, projectIds)` in `src/services/projectsService.ts`
Call the new archived-project delete route with `{projectIds}` using the repo's existing client API pattern
Invalidate `['projects']` and `['projects', 'archived']` after success and surface server errors using existing app patterns
`bun run lint` passes
`bun run build` passes

userStories.title: Add bulk delete UI to archived projects table
userStories.description: As a user, I want to select archived projects on `/projects/archived` and delete them in bulk so that I can permanently remove projects that I no longer need.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `src/app/routes/+projects/+archived/archivedProjectsTable.tsx` to use the reviews-table selection pattern with a checkbox column and select-all control
Show a top action bar with selected-count text and a destructive `Delete selected` action only when at least one current-page row is selected
Keep the row-level `Unarchive` action and use confirmation copy that says the delete is permanent and cannot restore the project
Clear selection after successful delete and keep selection scoped to the current archived page rows
`bun run lint` passes
`bun run build` passes
Verify in browser `/projects/archived` select, delete, refresh, confirm deleted projects are gone
